SR 26-2 supersedes SR 11-7 and SR 21-8; most relevant to Fed-regulated banking organizations over $30bn assets.
MindForge toolkit announced; consultation responses under review at that historical date. Four handbook areas: scope/oversight, AI risk management, lifecycle, enablers.
P017-2025 proposal identified; search non-discovery of a final instrument does not prove its absence.
DART and AI2 strategy terminology retained; not reread this cycle.
Identification numbers and lists of notified bodies; not a DPIA rule.
GPAI systemic-risk classification, including high-impact capabilities, Commission designation and a training-compute presumption above 10^25 FLOPs in the retrieved text.
Supersession of SR 11-7 and SR 21-8 reconfirmed.
